id: title:adboio:generate report canvases only for teams that use desktop

review.posthog_relevance: Adds implementation and documentation for the reports-to-canvas generation pipeline, gated by a feature flag and team space provisioning.
review.reason: The observed hunk P1.F1.H1 explicitly documents and implements a change allowing reports and reports awaiting input to run through the canvas generation pipeline. This is a substantive, bounded implementation change. The tier is assigned based on the presence of this implementation and documentation, not on unverified adoption or broader systemic impact.
review.uncertainty: The tier relies solely on the supplied observation; no independent verification of actual user benefit, incident avoidance, or production adoption is available. The score does not account for unverified outcomes.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a documentation and implementation change. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Documentation and implementation changes. No score assigned.
observations.code_quote: Ready reports and reports awaiting input can run through the canvas generation pipeline. This path is gated by the `signals-report-canvases` organization feature flag and by the team already having a general space. PostHog Desktop provisions that space on first run, so a team that does not use Desktop generates nothing and never has a space created for it.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds documentation and implementation changes. No score assigned.
